surface_mechanism_description: Me(CH3)~ precursors (where Me = In or Ga) are selectively adsorbed by column V atoms and then thermally decompose into Me atoms. These Me atoms participate in self-limited deposition, and the precursors not decomposed are desorbed within a time shorter than the purging time and do not take part in the self-limited deposition.
